content:
Is there a standard name in the topos / Heyting algebra literature for subobjects b with a < b ≤ ¬¬a, or for the situation where that range is nonempty (i.e. a not regular)?

Same question at the level of generalized elements: morphisms f : X → Y with Im(f) ≤ ¬¬a but Im(f) ≰ a.

I know about ¬¬ as a Lawvere–Tierney topology and j-density (the ¬¬a = ⊤ case), but those don't quite name what I'm after. Working on a sketch where this region needs to be distinguished from both a and ¬a. Any pointers appreciated.
